additional_concerns: Both extracted claims are supported by the full source; their references to missing licensed-firm and blackout context are stale because units u0, u11 and u12 supply that context.
The resubmission claim is misassigned to the five submission-compliance candidates: submission compliance and the historical trigger for resubmission are different typed questions.

The operational-launch interpretation is supported by u11 and u13; the governing timezone remains externally supplied, and the competing calendar-date interpretation must not silently extend the trigger into the blackout.
TRUE_IS_SATISFIED in the trigger candidates means satisfaction of the trigger predicate under the supplied control bindings, not performance or discharge of the resubmission duty.
node.a9c7e7d0e802f5a3fdf2abc2 assumes submission-specific certificate availability suffices; u30 requires an e-Cert but does not establish that operational sufficiency.

node.f75383097facdc52b0ac66f7 adds source-supported schema conformity to the selected submission control, but does not implement the separate requirement to liaise promptly to arrange a technical test; its combined control assignment remains unresolved.

The report-history predicate in node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3 is externally supplied rather than computed; a false result requires sufficient history and cannot establish discharge of an earlier duty.
No candidate establishes a resubmission deadline, and mere urgent contact during blackout must not automatically be classified as an STR submission.
